_comment: Plugin metadata for scripts/build_superclaude_plugin.py. Version is NOT defined here: the build script reads the repo VERSION file (PEP 440) and normalizes it to semver (e.g. 5.0.0a1 -> 5.0.0-alpha.1). plugin_version below is only a fallback when VERSION is missing.
plugin_description: Eval-gated toolkit for Claude Code — a few skills that beat native behavior, deterministic hooks, and optional MCP integrations. Less framework, more leverage.
marketplace_description: Official marketplace for the SuperClaude plugin.
